name: Christian Being In Love
overview: Scripture reveals that true Christian love is rooted in the love God showed by giving His only Son, calling believers to respond by loving one another and fulfilling God's law through love. Christians are warned against divided affection, as no one can serve both God and worldly wealth, emphasizing wholehearted devotion. Love among believers should be continual and sincere, free from covetousness, resting in the assurance that God will never abandon His people despite their shortcomings.
